papers.title: Comparison of effects of total hip arthroplasty and half hip arthroplasty on femoral neck fracture in elderly
papers.abstract:
Objective
To compare the effects of total hip arthroplasty (THA) and hemiarthroplasty (HA) on hip function on elderly patients with femoral neck fracture and the hip function after operation.


Methods
A total of 92 elderly patients with femoral neck fracture admitted in the First People’s Hospital of Yangquan from March 2016 to June 2017 were selected. According to the random number table method, they were divided into group A and group B, with 46 patients in each group. Total hip arthroplasty was used in group A and half hip arthroplasty was used in group B. Perioperative indicators, hip score (Harris hip score) and complications were compared between the two groups.


Results
The bleeding volume and total drainage volume in group B were significantly less than those in group A, the operation time and extubation time were shorter than those in group A, and the total weight-bearing time was longer (P<0.05). Harris score in group A was higher than that in group B at 6 months and 12 months after operation (P<0.05), and the incidence of complications in group A was significantly lower than that in group B (P<0.05).


Conclusions
Half hip arthroplasty can effectively shorten the operation time and tube removal time of elderly patients with femoral neck fracture, reduce the intraoperative blood loss, and the patient has good tolerance. Total hip replacement can better restore hip function and reduce the complications.


Key words: 
Femoral neck fracture; Elderly; Total hip replacement; Half hip arthroplasty; Hip function

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是纯粹的临床研究，无任何生物力学建模或有限元分析，与髋关节植入物力学研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical comparison study with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no FEA, and no implant mechanics analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较全髋与半髋置换对老年股骨颈骨折的效果。
summary_zh.method: 随机分组，对比围手术期指标、Harris评分和并发症。
summary_zh.result: 半髋缩短手术时间、减少出血；全髋更好恢复功能、降低并发症。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者的随机对照试验。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effects of total hip arthroplasty and hemiarthroplasty on hip function in elderly patients with femoral neck fracture.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial with 92 patients comparing perioperative indicators, Harris hip score, and complications.
summary_en.result: Hemiarthroplasty reduced operation time and blood loss, while total hip arthroplasty provided better functional recovery and fewer complications.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through a prospective randomized controlled study.
